changelog: Interactive Time & Shifts Dropdowns: Functional 'This Week' (This Week, Last Week, 2 Weeks Ago, 3 Weeks Ago) and Month Picker.
Streamlined Shift Arc Labels: Clean pill tags for Clock-In, Now, and Clock-Out avoiding any text overlap.
Active Real-Time Presence: Automatic Online status with active pulse for the current logged-in employee session.
Real Work From Home Calculation: Clean metric reflecting zero when all employees are on Hybrid/Office.
Multi-Platform Linux Support: Configured for AppImage and .deb distribution.
